overall: The AG found two violations: holding an August 28 meeting noticed as August 26, and removing and blocking a member of the public from the remote September 5 meeting. The Sept. 5 re-vote did not cure the wrong-date violation, but nullification was declined because the Board re-voted at a properly posted September 12 meeting. Other allegations were rejected.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board met in executive session on litigation strategy without a proper purpose, including one meeting with no posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Although it is a close question, we find that the discussions had in executive session on the dates in question concerned strategy with respect to possibly initiating litigation against Wiseacre Farm.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that posting paper notice of a fully remote meeting, with a Zoom address but no webinar ID or passcode, forced the public to transcribe the link.
allegations.key_passage: Although the steps required to access the Board meetings may have been inconvenient, they did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board removed and blocked members of the public from attending a remote meeting, including during public comment on September 5.
allegations.key_passage: Based upon the information before us, we find that at least one member of the public was removed from the remote September 5 meeting and was blocked from rejoining the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board cloaked an Open Meeting Law violation as a clerical error when describing the prior action; the letter did not separately rule on the label.
allegations.key_passage: We do not find that the Board violated the Law in the other ways alleged.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a notice topic lacked specificity and that the Board held a perfunctory vote on it without discussion.
allegations.key_passage: We do not find that the Board violated the Law in the other ways alleged.

allegations.summary: Board held an August 28 meeting although the posted notice listed the meeting date as Thursday, August 26.
allegations.key_passage: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it went forward with a meeting on Thursday, August 28 where the posted notice stated that the meeting would take place on “Thursday, August 26.”

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Board that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
